Durable construction for long service life
Ideal for locations with limited installation space
items.description:
Industrial roller shutter drives are engineered to deliver reliable, smooth, and efficient performance for commercial and industrial applications. Built with 100% copper winding, these drives ensure higher load capacity, enhanced durability, and long service life.

The drive system operates with low noise and minimal vibration while consuming very little power, making it energy-efficient and suitable for continuous operation. Its compact design allows installation even in locations where side margins are limited, as the drive can be mounted parallel to the roller shaft.

Manufactured using high-quality steel gearbox components, the system provides robust performance and dependable operation under demanding conditions. The inbuilt mechanical limit switch accurately controls the shutter position during both upward and downward movement, ensuring safe and precise operation.

For added safety, a specially designed safety lever near the sprocket automatically locks movement in the event of transmission chain failure. The system also includes an emergency manual hand chain operation, allowing uninterrupted usage during power failure situations.

Easy assembly, simple operation, space-saving construction, and industrial-grade reliability make these roller shutter drives a preferred choice across various industries.

characteristics.label: 100% copper winding for higher efficiency and durability
Energy-efficient operation with low power consumption
Parallel shaft mounting for limited side-space applications
Inbuilt mechanical limit switch for precise positioning
Safety locking lever for chain-break protection

items.shortDescription: High-performance industrial roller shutter drive engineered for durability, smooth operation, and enhanced safety. Designed with 100% copper winding, low-noise performance, compact installation, and emergency manual operation for reliable everyday use.

items.description: A tubular motor for residential shutters is a compact and efficient electric drive system designed to automate the operation of rolling shutters, garage shutters, and window shutters in homes. The motor is installed inside the shutter’s rolling tube, providing a clean and space-saving solution while ensuring smooth, quiet, and reliable opening and closing. Tubular motors enhance convenience, security, and energy efficiency by allowing users to control shutters through wall switches, remote controls, smart home systems, or mobile apps. Built with durable materials and advanced safety features such as overload protection and obstacle detection, these motors are suitable for daily residential use and can handle various shutter sizes and weights. Their low-noise operation, easy installation, and minimal maintenance make tubular motors an ideal choice for modern automated residential shutter systems.
